Product.name: Tenon M88 Single Smart Door
Product.short_description: A complete designer entrance door with the smart lock engineered in — frame, panel and access control as one unit.
Product.description:
The M88 is not a lock you fit to a door — it is the door, built with the intelligence already inside it. A full-height matte charcoal panel with vertical wood-grain inlays carries a flush digital lock and a slim gold handle, so the entrance reads as architecture rather than hardware.

Because the lock, frame and panel are engineered together, there is no alignment problem, no additional cutting on site and no gap for a lever to be forced. Access is by fingerprint, PIN, card, app or key, and every entry is recorded. The core is insulated and the unit is supplied with its frame, hinges and seals, ready for a single opening.

This is a specification purchase rather than an off-the-shelf one. We survey the opening, confirm hand and finish, and handle delivery and installation — typically for a principal entrance, a duplex or a shortlet where the door is the first thing a guest sees.

Flush integrated digital lock with fingerprint and PIN
Matte charcoal finish with vertical wood-grain inlays
Insulated core with acoustic and draught seals
App access, guest codes and full entry log
Surveyed, delivered and installed by our team

Product.name: Tenon A9X Smart Lock
Product.short_description: Push-pull smart lock with 3D fingerprint entry, PIN, card, app and key — the flagship of the Tenon range.
Product.description:
The A9X is Tenon's flagship push-pull lock, built for front doors that take a beating and still have to look expensive. The full-length handle lets you open with a single push once the lock has verified you, so there is no handle to twist, no key to fish for and no fumbling with bags in your hand.

Unlock with a 3D capacitive fingerprint, a PIN, an RFID card, the companion app or the mechanical key — five ways in, and an audit trail of every one of them. The A9X supports temporary e-keys so you can let a cleaner, a plumber or a shortlet guest in from anywhere, for a window you choose, then switch it off again. Tamper and forced-entry alarms, low-battery warnings and a USB-C emergency port mean a flat battery never locks you out.

Finished in matte black with gold detailing, it suits solid timber and heavy composite doors up to 55mm. Installation by our technicians is available across Lagos and Abuja.
features: Push-pull opening — one motion to enter
3D capacitive fingerprint reader (stores up to 100 prints)
PIN code, RFID card, app and mechanical key backup
Temporary and one-time e-keys for guests and artisans
Rechargeable lithium battery with up to 12 months standby

Product.name: Tenon K9 Smart Lock
Product.short_description: Compact keypad smart lock with fingerprint entry and app control — the everyday workhorse.
Product.description:
The K9 is the lock we fit most often: a compact, square-fronted smart lock that replaces a standard handle set without any drama. It brings fingerprint, PIN, card, app and key access to a door you already have, which makes it the simplest way to go keyless in a flat, a shortlet or a small office.

The illuminated keypad works at night, the fingerprint reader reads through wet or dusty fingers, and the app lets you issue a code to a visitor from wherever you are. Every entry is logged, so you always know who came in and when. Anti-peep PIN entry lets you type random digits around your real code when someone is watching.

Brushed gunmetal finish over a zinc alloy body, rated for doors from 35 to 50mm. Battery life is roughly a year on four AA cells, with a low-battery alert well before you need to act.

Anti-peep PIN entry for shoulder-proof unlocking

Entry log in the Tenon Home app
Low-battery alert and emergency power port

Product.name: Tenon A2 Smart Lock
Product.short_description: Gold-bronze handle lock with glass keypad — designed to look like jewellery on a premium door.
Product.description:
The A2 is the lock you fit when the door cost more than the lock. A gold-bronze lever handle carries a black glass keypad panel, so the hardware reads as part of the joinery rather than a gadget bolted onto it.

Underneath the finish it is a serious piece of access control: fingerprint, PIN, card, app and key, with individual user profiles, temporary codes for guests and a full entry history. The handle mechanism is designed for tall, heavy pivot doors, and the lock is supplied with a mortise body rated for daily residential and light commercial use.

Because the electronics sit in a sealed glass-faced panel, cleaning is simple and the finish does not pit in humid coastal air — useful in Lagos and Port Harcourt. Available with matching handles for double doors.

Product.name: Tenon K5 Smart Glass Door Lock
Product.short_description: Clamp-on smart lock for frameless glass doors — no drilling through the glass.
Product.description:
Glass doors are the hardest thing to secure without ruining them. The K5 clamps onto the edge of a frameless tempered glass door, so nothing is drilled through the panel and the door keeps its clean look.

It brings fingerprint, PIN, card, app and key access to offices, showrooms, pharmacies and modern homes with glass entrances. The reader sits at hand height on the fixed side, the lock body on the door, and a single swipe lets you in. Access can be time-limited, so staff codes stop working after hours and the cleaner's code works on Saturday morning only.

Satin black finish, supplied with the glass clamp kit and a backup mechanical key. Works with 10 – 12mm tempered glass; our team can survey and fit it for you.
features: Clamp-on fitting — no drilling through the glass

Product.name: Tenon K6 Minimalistic Smart Lock
Product.short_description: Slim, almost invisible smart lock with a single LED line — for interior doors and modern joinery.
Product.description:
Some doors should not be interrupted. The K6 is a slim panel in soft champagne metal with one thin LED line, so from two metres away it reads as part of the door rather than a security device.

It is a full access-control lock underneath: fingerprint, PIN, RFID card, app and key, with per-user profiles and a quiet motorised latch that closes without a slam — which matters in bedrooms, studies and apartments where doors are opened at night.

The K6 fits flush into standard interior door preparations and works well alongside the A9X on the front door, sharing one app and one set of users. If you are fitting more than two, our team can set them all up from a single phone before we leave.
features: Slim flush panel with a single LED status line
Fingerprint, PIN, card, app and key access
Quiet motorised latch — no door slam
Ideal for bedrooms, studies and interior doors
Shares users and codes with other Tenon locks in one app
Reversible for left or right hand doors

Product.name: Tenon T15 Smart Lock
Product.short_description: Tall graphite rim lock with fingerprint and keypad — a direct swap for existing rim locks.
Product.description:
The T15 is the straight swap for the rim lock already on your door. It mounts on the same surface, uses the same fixing points in most cases, and gives you fingerprint and keypad entry in an afternoon instead of a renovation.

That makes it the practical choice for older duplexes, gatehouse doors and rental apartments where you want smart access without cutting the door or replacing the frame. It is built around a hardened steel latch and a graphite-finish body that takes knocks without showing them.

Multiple PINs, fingerprint profiles and cards can be set, temporary codes can be issued from the app, and a mechanical key is always there as a last resort. Rated for outdoor and covered exterior doors.
features: Direct replacement for standard rim locks
Temporary codes issued from the app

Faq.question: Do Hamthel smart locks work without internet?
Faq.answer: Yes. Fingerprint, PIN and card access all run on the lock itself, so your door opens whether or not there is Wi-Fi or power. The app adds remote control and notifications when the lock is connected.

Faq.question: What happens during a power cut?
Faq.answer: Every lock runs on batteries — typically 8 to 12 months per set. Each unit also has USB-C emergency power and a mechanical key override, so you are never locked out.

Faq.question: Do you install, or do I need my own carpenter?
Faq.answer: Both are possible. Our technicians install in Lagos and Abuja, and we can advise your carpenter for other locations. Send us a photo of your door and we will tell you exactly what fits.

Faq.question: Will it fit my existing door?
Faq.answer: Most standard Nigerian entrance doors are compatible. We ask for door thickness and a photo before shipping, and retrofit options exist if you would rather not cut a new door.

Faq.question: What is covered by the warranty?
Faq.answer: 12 to 24 months depending on the model, covering manufacturing faults. We handle repairs or replacement directly — no shipping the unit abroad and waiting.

Faq.question: Can I return an item?
Faq.answer: Yes. Uninstalled products in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Installed locks are covered by warranty rather than return, since they cannot be resold.
